description: This file defines multiple interfaces within the WPEFramework project, specifically related to Controller functionalities such as system management, discovery, configuration, lifecycle management, and metadata. It contains pure virtual classes (interfaces) with methods intended for remote procedure calls and event notifications, serving as a contract for implementations.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations like rebooting, environment variable retrieval, directory cleanup, and plugin cloning.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery functionalities such as starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration management, providing methods to persist data and access configuration values.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle events, including activation, deactivation, suspension, resumption, and state notifications.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface to obtain various metadata about the framework, proxies, plugins, and system status.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a specified directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts network discovery process with a specified TTL.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Provides the results of network discovery.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores the current configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves or sets configuration data associated with a callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a sink for lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a sink from lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin identified by callsign.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin identified by callsign.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable for interaction.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin into Hibernate state with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details of currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status and configuration information of a plugin.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides details about active connections.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides information about the framework process, such as worker pools.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides details about active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides the framework's version and hash.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides call stack information for a specific thread index.
